title: very sturdy
text: very sturdy. I bought this rack for a couple of reasons... I liked that it folds flat for storage and that it seemed to be very strong.  I was very happy when it arrived initially because it is mostly assembled and very easy to understand as to how the rest assembles.  I would have given it 5 stars but I ended up having some missing screws and had to deal with the sellers "customer service."  A very, very disappointing experience.  After doing everything but stand on my head, they agreed to send the two screws that were missing from the box. (The screws were to attach the the clips which keep the top rack piece all together with the base when not in use). Further, the seller uses F E D E X to ship... so the box was really beat up and had a 4x4" hole in it.  The rack was not padded in the box in any way, but managed to arrive undamaged, except for the warehouse forgetting to include the screws.  If you don't have to deal with the seller for some reason, you will be very pleased with the rack I believe.  It is very sturdy.  Folds up so nicely and conveniently.  You should know the wheels do NOT have locks on them.  The wheels are very sturdy as well, industrial almost.  This rack is built to last for some time.  You'll spend a bit more, but honestly, you get what you pay for.  I plan to try it out at my Mom's garage sale in a few weeks.  That should be a good test of it's ability.  I will also update IF the screws ever arrive.  I have my doubts.  Bottom line: Great quality, sturdy, commercial rack. I would buy this brand again but would consider other sellers.
